summary: Frontend-only verification of 5 UI changes on Meelora app: (1) login logo directly on navy panel with no white card, (2) user avatar with initials fallback in top-right header, (3) floating dropdown user menu, (4) sidebar profile block + 'Votre entreprise, clairement.' tagline removed, (5) photo upload via file input. All 5 changes verified working. Non-regression checks on navigation (dashboard/budget/acct_dashboard/acct_qc9434) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js is 427 lines - close to but under the 700 line threshold; consider extracting UserMenu, NavItem/NavParent, YearControls, CompanySelector into separate files for maintainability.
Unused state in LayoutInner: userMenuOpen and avatarColor states are declared but no longer used after the sidebar profile block was removed. Dead code can be cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded 1x1 PNG avatar for admin user via UI; backend accepted (toast 'Photo de profil mise à jour').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI restructuring done: header avatar dropdown works, initials fallback 'BB' for Bikuma B., role badge Admin visible, all menu items present (avatar-change, avatar-remove, menu-profile, menu-users, logout-btn, avatar-file-input). Login logo loads (naturalWidth=1863) with transparent bg on navy. Sidebar tagline gone. Avatar upload via set_input_files works. Note: after set_input_files the dropdown may close (Radix behavior), so re-open menu before clicking logout in future scripts.

detailed_observations.nav_regression: nav-dashboard, nav-budget, nav-acct_dashboard, nav-acct_qc9434 all clickable
detailed_observations.avatar_upload_toast: Photo de profil mise à jour (success)
